params.description: filter the packages by status. Status can be All|NotShipped|Shipped|Delivered For example: Status.All

params.description: Used for searching packages from specified date Use the node as date_after if specified date is not to be considered

params.name: date_end
params.description: Used for searching packages till specified date Use the node as date_before if specified date is not to be considered

params.name: shipment_date_start

params.name: shipment_date_end
